numbering: Episodes numbered continuously 1–36 across all three seasons (Season 2 is 13–24, Season 3 is 25–36); chapters are the Murata-illustrated manga.

arcs.name: Introduction and House of Evolution
arcs.summary: Saitama trained so hard he can now defeat any enemy with one punch, which has left him bored. He picks up a cyborg disciple, Genos.
events: Saitama one-shots Vaccine Man and other monsters with no effort.
Genos asks to become Saitama's disciple after Saitama saves him.
Saitama dismantles the House of Evolution and its experiments.

arcs.name: Hero Association and the Meteor
arcs.summary: Saitama joins the official Hero Association, only to find that rankings and recognition don't come easily.
events: Speed-o'-Sound Sonic declares himself Saitama's rival.
Saitama aces the physical test but barely passes the written exam, starting at Class C.
Saitama destroys a meteor heading for City Z, but gets blamed for the debris.

arcs.name: Deep Sea King
arcs.summary: Sea monsters invade from the ocean, and their leader tears through every hero sent against him.
events: Mumen Rider faces the Deep Sea King despite having no chance.
Saitama finishes the Deep Sea King with one punch and then lets the crowd blame him.

arcs.name: Dark Matter Thieves
arcs.summary: A massive alien ship appears over City A, led by a conqueror who has sought a worthy opponent.
events: S-Class heroes fight off the invaders.
Saitama finally has a real fight against Boros and wins with a Serious Punch.

arcs.name: Hero Hunt
arcs.summary: A martial artist named Garou, who sympathizes with monsters, starts hunting heroes.
events: Garou leaves Silver Fang's dojo and beats several heroes.
Monsters claim a new Monster Association is forming.
Metal Bat stands up to Garou while protecting his sister.

arcs.name: Super Fight
arcs.summary: Saitama enters a martial arts tournament in disguise to learn about fighting techniques.
events: Saitama fights as 'Charanko' and keeps winning without trying.
Monsters crash the tournament.

arcs.name: Monster Association Uprising
arcs.summary: The Monster Association strikes heroes everywhere at once and kidnaps a hero's child.
events: The S-Class heroes hold an emergency meeting.
Garou keeps beating stronger heroes and barely survives Bang and Bomb.
The Monster Association kidnaps Waganma, the son of a Hero Association executive, setting up a rescue mission.

arcs.name: Monster Association Raid
arcs.summary: The Hero Association launches an all-out assault on the Monster Association's underground lair.
events: S-Class heroes split up in the monsters' labyrinthine base.
Saitama wanders the base and keeps beating dragon-level monsters by accident.
Tatsumaki and other S-Class heroes battle the Association's Dragon-level executives.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga (specials and the OVA sit outside the numbering).
